notes:
Inbound self-serve signup (trial) 2026-02-25. CTO Ari Levine leading POC for automated support replies + ticket summarization. Using hosted API; primarily public cloud.

Observed failure modes during PoC: 
- Streaming (json mode) frequently yields invalid JSON chunks on the client side; parser errors on Node backend.
- Function/tool-calling schema mismatches: our schema defines ticket_id as string but client code expects integer -> deserialization errors.
- Intermittent control characters (\u0000) observed in chunk boundaries when streaming from SDK wrapper.

Customer environment: Node frontend (React) -> Python backend (FastAPI). Using Redwood JS SDK v0.2.x and sometimes raw fetch for streaming.

Customer quote from 2026-03-01 call: "We get JSONDecodeError on roughly every 3rd streaming response when func-calls are enabled — breaks our consumer pipeline."

Priority: medium (SMB) — willing to pay hosted for simplicity but needs stability for streaming and deterministic tool-calls. Wants: a) recommended function schema patterns (types + required fields), b) example server-side streaming consumer code that tolerates chunk boundaries, c) SDK config flags to ensure atomic JSON per event or reliable framing.

Notes from interactions: "gave initial SDK patch suggestion on 2026-03-04; customer reported partial improvement but still sees malformed chunk at higher concurrency". POC docs and logs stored (drive link). Jira INF-3421 created for engineering investigation.
